_usage: Corrections the ingest heuristics cannot make. 'files': globs over paths relative to the domain lake (forward slashes) -> {"parser": "report" | "sniff", "merge_continuations": true to append blank-line-separated rows to the table above}. 'tables': final table name -> {"columns": {old: new}, "melt": {"id": row-key column (omit if none), "id_to": its new name, "names_to": column for the old headers, "values_to": column for the cells}, "rename_to": new table name, "reason": why}. 'melt' stores a matrix sheet (headers are values: samples, genes, codes) as long rows, dropping empty cells. Each correction is recorded in the table's notes.

SN_y_tot_V2_0.reason: the SILSO yearly file has no header; names follow the SILSO SN_y_tot_V2.0 format description (-1 means not available; marker 1 = definitive)

2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Report.reason: the source CSV labels its first two columns in the wrong order (values are year, then theft type)

2024_CSN_Data_Contributors__section4.reason: the source CSV puts the section title in the Year header cell

1_s2_0_S0092867420301070_mmc2__A_global_.reason: protein x sample matrix (one column per sample S001-S153, the case ids in mmc1.idx); stored as one row per protein and sample, empty cells omitted. Values are median-polished, log2-transformed global protein abundance (mmc2 README)

1_s2_0_S0092867420301070_mmc2__B_phospho.reason: phosphosite x sample matrix (one column per sample S001-S153, the case ids in mmc1.idx; sites are GENE-residue, e.g. CHEK2-S163); stored as one row per site and sample, empty cells omitted. Values are median-polished, log2-transformed phosphosite abundance (mmc2 README)

1_s2_0_S0092867420301070_mmc5__B_circRNA.reason: circRNA x RNA-binding-protein matrix (one column per RBP gene); stored as one row per circRNA and RBP. The README calls the values correlations between circRNA expression and RBP abundance, but they all lie in 0.10-1.0 and some RBP columns are all 1, so they may be p-values rather than coefficients

state_abbreviation_to_state.reason: one-row sheet whose headers are the state abbreviations and whose cells are the state names; stored as one row per state
